review.scope: Completed source proof/certificate/audit/replay claims carried as reported. No new Capital audit or execution; prior P2 transfer holds binding.

title: Certify local forgetting from retained reservoir probes despite slow hidden global mixing
statement: For the declared exclusion/closure-defect class, fair-sign reservoir perturbations certify local reference memory from a retained dependent record. Fixed additional source combinations inherit a local-mean bias bound even when hidden global mixing grows without bound.

evidence.range_scope: Transport/defect class, retained fair-sign reservoir probes, exact dependent-trial confidence and fixed-combination local-mean transfer.

evidence.quote: ## 4. The foundational consequence is a separation of local and global memory
evidence.range_scope: Constructed local/global memory separation, actual acquired versus analytic bounds and stronger direct-acquisition comparator with unexecuted protocol scope.

requires: The source is an exclusion network with at most one particle per site, vacancy-limited hopping and accessible reservoir contacts. The symmetric reference has local memory s_i(t)=[exp(-(L+R)t)1]_i, the backward-walker survival before reservoir absorption. Here L is the reference transport Laplacian and R the reservoir-rate operator, not the global exit-rate ceiling of a different endpoint-simulator theorem. Hidden bulk may have no reservoir refresh. The transport class and closure-defect guarantee remain externally warranted premises.

Accessible reservoir density probes 1/2+aZ with fresh fair signs and unchanged total exchange rates. Controls fixed during each interval, reproducible source strengths, complete source transport/defect contract and admissible eta. No reset or independent hidden-state preparation is assumed.

The source score transformation, exact integer binomial-tail inversion and simultaneous confidence allocation. Full contract/certificate originals are reported but unacquired; do not invent a score-tail formula from this summary.
provides: At each trial choose a fresh fair sign Z, set accessible reservoir densities to 1/2+aZ while preserving their total exchange rates, hold controls fixed for tau and read binary local occupancy Y_i. Both possible signs start from the same carried hidden state; only the realized branch is run. In the symmetric case E[Z(2Y_i-1)|entire history]=2a(1-s_i(tau)). No reset, stationary start or copied physical branch is used. For directed exclusion the nonlinear residual has width h_i=sum_j |(q_ij-q_ji)/2|. Under h_i<=eta*r_i, E[Z(2Y_i-1)|history]<=(2a+eta)(1-s_i(tau)). Binary score transformation and binomial stochastic domination handle dependent trials; exact integer tail inversion gives an upper confidence bound S_i.

For the source admissible defect/control contract, every allowed fixed combination of additional source injections obeys |E_x X_i(t)-rho_i^u|<=eta+(1-eta)S_i for t>=tau. Source strengths remain reproducible, probes preserve exchange kinetics and controls remain fixed within each sampling interval. Baseline and isolated-control observations then enclose later joint stationary means through the source retained intervention-composition construction. This is local-mean control, not arbitrary feedback or the full hidden-state law.

For the constructed family, L unrefreshed bulk sites behind a neck of rate gamma give t_mix(epsilon)>=(1-2epsilon)L/(2gamma),0<epsilon<1/2, comparing initially full/empty bulk. Global mixing can grow without bound while accessible-port reference memory stays uniformly small: analytical upper bound at time4 below0.001584 independently of bulk size. The executed learner actually uses the looser acquired bound at most0.020017435. Bulk material is paid and does not increase local throughput.
assumptions: The two sign possibilities are conditional on the same carried hidden state; only one is physically realized. Randomization cancels the unknown initial contribution in expectation, not through copied branches.
The structural class/defect bound is warranted externally. Confidence concerns local means for allowed fixed controls, not arbitrary feedback, full-state stationarity or all interacting systems.
Analytical local memory below0.001584 and measured learner bound0.020017435 are different; the acquired bound is the one used in execution. The neck family pays its bulk material.
costs: Actual retained probe durations, reads, reservoir settings, source strengths and dependence-aware confidence. No free stationary conditional, global mixing estimate or bulk refresh.
The constructed t_mix lower bound scales with hidden bulk L/gamma; local throughput does not grow with unobserved material.
contract.units: Occupancy in[0,1]; s_i survival/reference memory; local confidence S_i; L transport Laplacian versus separately named bulk-size variable in the mixing example; R reservoir operator; model time, not seconds.
contract.obstruction: Detector energy, switching work, clocks, computation, erasure, fabrication, external reservoir preparation and final reset remain unpriced. No conversion of model time/site count to seconds/fabricated area is supplied. Physical implementation remains unresolved; no complete-device efficiency or industrial-throughput claim follows.

body: Established absorbing-walk/exclusion machinery is an input. The reported addition is a finite acquired premise for retained intervention composition without full stationary conditionals. No proof replay or original audit acquisition by Capital.
